why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Create an account on Nous Portal . You can sign in with email, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, Discord or a wallet. The free tier costs nothing and covers free models only.

Install Hermes Agent from Nous's official docs and sign in with your Portal account. Warning The official install is a command that downloads a script and runs it in your terminal. Copy it only from Nous's own docs or GitHub, never from a post or a direct message.
Join the official Discord through the invite on Nous's site, discord.gg/nousresearch.
If you have data-centre-class GPUs, read the Psyche docs on GitHub and ask a run administrator to authorise your wallet.
costs: Hermes Agent is free, and the Portal's free tier costs $0. Paid plans cost $20, $100 or $200 a month, each with about 10% extra in credits, and top-ups start at $10. The terms say: "All Fees are non-refundable." Running a Psyche node takes your own GPU and SOL for transaction fees.
risks: Nothing you do with Nous's products is promised a reward. Any airdrop is speculation. Psyche is still a test network. Its legal page says testnet tokens "have no economic or monetary value". Promoters have pushed a Portal waitlist for an airdrop. Nous has made no airdrop claim, so treat such links as unofficial.
